title: Settings
interfaceHint: The language Lingora is shown in.
notesHint: Conversations are saved on your computer so you can view, export or summarize them.
saveHint: Every time you translate, a note is created in Notes.
speakersMissing: An add-on is missing (~40 MB): download it in “Diagnostics and downloads” below.
speakersHint: Labels who is speaking in the notes: Person 1, Person 2… Processed on your computer.
summaryLangHint: Note-taking summaries are written in this language. You can change it on each note.
diagnosticsHint: What Lingora needs to listen, translate, speak and summarize.
aboutPrivate: Everything runs on your computer: audio and text never leave it.
myNameHint: In notes, what you say into your microphone shows as "{label}".
aboutWithKey: Everything runs on your computer, except the summaries you ask for: that transcript is sent to {name}.
